Hallo zusammen,
Mein Name ist Benjamin Perske und ich arbeite für die Firma AKKODIS DCE an einem Ladeinfrastrukturprojekt für die Firma BMW.
Leider kam es bei einer ihrer Ladesäulen zu einer Auffälligkeit, denn die Ladestation rampte die Ladeleistung nur sehr langsam hoch.
Es handelt sich um folgende Säule:
ID: 227487
S/N: MP / R3 170001340

additional_info.subject: Reported issue Translation
additional_info.body:
Hello everyone,
My name is Benjamin Perske, and I work for AKKODIS DCE on a charging infrastructure project for BMW.
Unfortunately, one of their charging stations was experiencing an issue: the charging station was ramping up its charging power very slowly.
This station is the following:
ID: 227487
S/N: MP / R3 170001340
Location: HPC V-Markt Füssen, Kemptener Straße 107
Date: June 22, 2025, 8:12:18 PM
Are there any known issues with this station, or could you please take a look at this case?
Thank you in advance for your feedback.
Best regards

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437434DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001340]Charging power ramps up slowly V-Markt Füssen CRM:02678000134
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin Perske,
Greetings of the day!
We have reviewed the charging session logs, and the details are as follows:
Session Start Time (UTC):
2025-06-22, 18:05:25
Session Stop Time (UTC):
2025-06-22, 18:23:49
Transaction ID:
85502389
During the session, the charger delivered power up to
150 kW
. However, there was an internal communication error due to which
two converters were intermittently not detected
.
Currently, two converters are still not detected due to a CAN communication error. We will attempt to resolve this remotely. If the issue persists, we will escalate it to our regional field service team for an onsite visit. We will keep you informed on the progress accordingly.
With best regards,
